title: O bairro do hotel
grammarPoint: There is / there are; some / any

text.title: Welcome to the Maple Street Hotel
paragraphs: The Maple Street Hotel is in a quiet neighborhood in Portland, Oregon, ten minutes from [[downtown]]. Here is a short guide to the area around the hotel.
There is a big park [[across the street]]. In the morning, there are always people running or walking their dogs. There is also a small [[farmers market]] in the park every Saturday.
On Maple Street, there are some great places to eat. There's a Mexican restaurant, a pizza place and two coffee shops. There isn't a supermarket on our street, but there is one [[two blocks away]].

Are there any museums [[nearby]]? Yes, there are! The Art Museum is a fifteen-minute walk from the hotel. There aren't any big shopping malls in the neighborhood, but there are some cute little shops on Pine Street.
Do you need help? There is always someone at the [[front desk]], day and night.

downtown.note: Nos EUA, downtown é o centro comercial da cidade.

two blocks away.note: block = quarteirão; nos EUA, as distâncias na cidade são contadas em blocks.

grammar.title: There is / there are: dizer o que tem em um lugar
explanation: Em português dizemos "tem um parque" ou "há um parque". Em inglês, usamos there is ou there are. Cuidado: não usamos have para isso. "Tem um parque aqui" é There is a park here, e não It has a park here.
There is (ou a contração there's) vem com uma coisa no singular: there is a big park. There are vem com várias coisas, no plural: there are two coffee shops.

Na negativa: there isn't a supermarket, there aren't any malls. Na pergunta, is ou are vêm antes de there: Is there a pharmacy? Are there any museums? Respostas curtas: Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.
Some e any significam "alguns" ou "algumas". Usamos some em frases afirmativas (there are some great places) e any em frases negativas e perguntas (there aren't any malls, are there any museums?).

examples.en: There is a big park across the street.
examples.pt: Tem um parque grande do outro lado da rua.

examples.en: There are some great places to eat.
examples.pt: Tem alguns lugares ótimos para comer.

examples.en: There isn't a supermarket on our street.
examples.pt: Não tem supermercado na nossa rua.

exercises.prompt: O que tem do outro lado da rua do hotel?
exercises.explanation: O texto diz: "There is a big park across the street."

exercises.statement: There is a supermarket on Maple Street.
exercises.explanation: Falso: "There isn't a supermarket on our street". O supermercado fica a dois quarteirões.
O texto diz: "a small farmers market in the park every Saturday".

exercises.statement: There are some small shops on Pine Street.
exercises.explanation: Verdadeiro: "there are some cute little shops on Pine Street".

exercises.sentence: There ___ two coffee shops on Maple Street.
exercises.explanation: Two coffee shops está no plural, então usamos there are.

exercises.sentence: There aren't ___ big shopping malls in the neighborhood.
exercises.explanation: Em frases negativas, usamos any: there aren't any malls.

exercises.sentence: ___ there a pharmacy near the hotel?
exercises.explanation: Na pergunta, is vem antes de there. A pharmacy está no singular, então: Is there...?

exercises.prompt: Como se diz "Tem um restaurante mexicano na rua"?
options: There is a Mexican restaurant on the street.
It has a Mexican restaurant on the street.
Have a Mexican restaurant on the street.
exercises.explanation: Para dizer que algo existe em um lugar, usamos there is. Em inglês, "tem" nesse sentido não é have.

exercises.prompt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
exercises.explanation: Na pergunta, are vem antes de there, e usamos any: Are there any museums nearby?
